definitions: To begin to be in a particular state or condition, often an undesirable one.
To be divided into or to belong to a particular category or group.
To start doing something without intending to.
To collapse or break into pieces.
To come under the control or possession of someone or something.
examples: The old house began to fall into disrepair.
These expenses fall into the 'miscellaneous' category.
We fell into a routine very quickly.
The bridge might fall into the river if not repaired.
The company could fall into the hands of its competitors.
